title: Upper Bounds on the Comon Rank Gap of Real Symmetric Third-Order Tensors
summary: Let $T$ be a nonzero real symmetric third-order tensor. Denote by $r(T)$ its CP rank, by $s(T)$ its symmetric rank, by $d(T)$ its essential dimension, and put $e(T)=r(T)-d(T)$. We establish two complementary upper bounds for the Comon rank gap $$Δ(T):= s(T)-r(T)\leq\min\{C_{ec}(e(T)),\ C_{dc}(d(T))\}.$$ The excess-controlled function $C_{ec}(e)$ is zero for $0\leq e\leq3$ and equals $9e-3$ for $e\geq4$. In particular, the equality $C_{ec}(e(T))=0$ for $0\leq e\leq3$ extends Friedland's flattening-rank criterion for real symmetric third-order tensors by two additional rank layers. The…
